set.body:
Requested by a downstream desktop host (eyes4s Studio), stated generically.

Problem
JavaFxCanvasContext keeps unbounded image and pattern maps, with no clear or release and no stated texture-size limit. A long-lived host that redraws changing rasters (heatmaps, animation frames) can only bound memory by discarding the whole context. Verified at 2fa5c68.

Scope
- Bounded caches, for example LRU by bytes, with explicit release()/clear().
- A documented maximum raster dimension. It is either the JavaFX texture limit queried where possible or a stated conservative constant, with a typed error beyond it.
- A disposal hook that controllers can call.

Acceptance criteria
1. Redrawing N distinct rasters keeps retained cache bytes under the bound (test).
2. release() frees native images (a weak-reference test).
3. An over-limit raster fails with a typed error that names its dimensions.
set.title: [Intaglio][JavaFX] Bounded, releasable resource cache and stated max raster size for JavaFxCanvasContext
